headline: Engineering Goods Exports: US, UK, China and other countries give India a big boost; feat achieved for 5th consecutive month
summary: India's engineering goods exports rose 25% year-on-year in August, according to EEPC India. Strong demand from the US, UK, South Korea, China and Indonesia drove growth, extending gains for a fifth consecutive month.
why: Engineering goods are a major category of India's merchandise exports, and their performance is an indicator of manufacturing demand and trade flows.
